# 1.Research Design
To what extent are room type, number of bedrooms, and review scores associated with Airbnb listing prices in Edinburgh?


# 2.Model Summary
DV: price
IV: room_type / bedrooms / review_scores_rating

M1	Bivariate regression：Price ~ Room type
M2	Multiple linear regression：Price ~ Room type + Bedrooms + Review score

# 3.Hypotheses
M1:
- H₀: The overall average prices of the three types of rooms are equal.
- H₁: At least one of the overall average prices of the room types is different.
M2:
- H₀: All regression coefficients except the intercept are zero.
- H₁: At least one of the regression coefficients is not zero.

# 4.Explore the Variables

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
listings_clean <- readRDS("listings_clean.rds")

head(listings_clean)
```


```{r}
required_vars <- c(
  "price",
  "room_type",
  "bedrooms",
  "review_scores_rating"
)

# 构建模型分析数据集
model_data <- listings_clean |>
  select(all_of(required_vars)) |>

  # 将房型设置为分类变量
  mutate(
    room_type = factor(room_type)
  ) |>

  # 删除四个变量中存在缺失值的记录
  drop_na() |>

  # 删除无穷数及非正价格
  filter(
    is.finite(price),
    is.finite(bedrooms),
    is.finite(review_scores_rating),
    price > 0
  ) |>

  # 删除未使用的分类水平
  droplevels()
```


```{r}
# 设置整套房源作为参照组
model_data <- model_data |>
  mutate(
    room_type = relevel(
      room_type,
      ref = "Entire home/apt"
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# 查看清洗前后的样本量
cat("Original sample:", nrow(listings_clean), "\n")
cat("Analysis sample:", nrow(model_data), "\n")
cat("Excluded observations:",
    nrow(listings_clean) - nrow(model_data), "\n")

# 检查房型类别
levels(model_data$room_type)

# 检查模型数据结构
glimpse(model_data)
```

**为什么要进行这一步？**

本次 M1 和 M2 都使用 `model_data`，保证两个模型基于相同的观测样本。

否则，如果 M1 使用全部 13,647 条价格记录，而 M2 排除了评分缺失记录，就很难区分模型表现的变化究竟来自新增变量，还是来自样本发生变化。

需要注意，这里的完整案例分析可能带来样本选择偏差，因此后续应说明缺失记录的处理方式。

## 3.3 Descriptive Statistics

```{r descriptive-statistics}
model_data |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_price = mean(price),
    median_price = median(price),
    sd_price = sd(price),
    min_price = min(price),
    max_price = max(price),
    mean_bedrooms = mean(bedrooms),
    mean_rating = mean(review_scores_rating)
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```


```{r descriptive-statistics}
room_summary <- model_data |>
  group_by(room_type) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_price = mean(price),
    median_price = median(price),
    sd_price = sd(price),
    Q1 = quantile(price, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(price, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

room_summary |>
  kable(
    digits = 2,
    caption = "Airbnb Prices by Room Type"
  )
```

## 3.4 Visualise the Variables

### Figure 1. Distribution of Price

```{r price-histogram}
ggplot(model_data, aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 20,
    fill = "skyblue",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Airbnb Prices",
    x = "Price (£)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Figure 2. Price by Room Type

```{r room-boxplot}
ggplot(
  model_data,
  aes(x = room_type, y = price, fill = room_type)
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Airbnb Prices by Room Type",
    x = "Room Type",
    y = "Price (£)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Figure 3. Bedrooms and Price

```{r bedroom-scatter}
ggplot(
  model_data,
  aes(x = bedrooms, y = price)
) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +

  # 蓝线为简单线性拟合线
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "blue"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bedrooms and Airbnb Price",
    x = "Number of Bedrooms",
    y = "Price (£)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Figure 4. Review Scores and Price

```{r rating-scatter}
ggplot(
  model_data,
  aes(x = review_scores_rating, y = price)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "blue"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Review Scores and Airbnb Prices",
    x = "Review Score",
    y = "Price (£)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Part 4. Bivariate Linear Regression

## 4.1 Build Model 1

```{r model-1}
model_1 <- lm(
  price ~ room_type,
  data = model_data
)
```


```{r model-1}
summary(model_1)
```


```{r model-1}
# 查看各系数的95%置信区间
confint(model_1)
```


```{r model-1}
# 检验房型整体是否具有统计显著性
anova(model_1)
```

## 4.2 Interpret Model 1

运行 `summary(model_1)` 后，重点回答以下问题：

1. What is the intercept? 它代表什么？
2. Are the room-type coefficients positive or negative?
3. Are the differences statistically significant?
4. What proportion of price variation is explained by room type?

**注意：这里暂时不要填写具体的回归系数，因为它们需要根据上述模型实际运行结果确定。**

## 4.3 Residual Diagnostics for Model 1

```{r model-1-diagnostics, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# 使用四张标准诊断图
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

plot(
  model_1,
  which = c(1, 2, 3, 5)
)

# 恢复默认绘图布局
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## 4.4 Model 1 Residual Summary

```{r model-1-residuals}
# 提取残差
residuals_m1 <- residuals(model_1)

# 查看残差的分布
summary(residuals_m1)

# 计算残差的标准差
sd(residuals_m1)

# 检查残差均值
mean(residuals_m1)
```

# Part 5. Multiple Linear Regression

## 5.1 Build Model 2

```{r model-2}
model_2 <- lm(
  price ~ room_type +
    bedrooms +
    review_scores_rating,
  data = model_data
)

# 查看完整回归结果
summary(model_2)

# 查看95%置信区间
confint(model_2)
```

## 5.2 Examine Individual Predictors

```{r model-2-predictors}
drop1(
  model_2,
  test = "F"
)
```

## 5.3 Residual Diagnostics for Model 2

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

plot(
  model_2,
  which = c(1, 2, 3, 5)
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## 5.4 Model 2 Residual Summary

```{r model-2-residuals}
# 提取多元回归的残差
residuals_m2 <- residuals(model_2)

# 查看分布
summary(residuals_m2)

# 残差均值
mean(residuals_m2)

# 残差标准差
sd(residuals_m2)
```

# Part 6. Compare the Two Models

## 6.1 Compare Model Performance

```{r compare-models}
model_comparison <- tibble(
  Model = c("M1", "M2"),

  N = c(
    nobs(model_1),
    nobs(model_2)
  ),

  R_squared = c(
    summary(model_1)$r.squared,
    summary(model_2)$r.squared
  ),

  Adjusted_R2 = c(
    summary(model_1)$adj.r.squared,
    summary(model_2)$adj.r.squared
  ),

  Residual_SE = c(
    summary(model_1)$sigma,
    summary(model_2)$sigma
  ),

  AIC = c(
    AIC(model_1),
    AIC(model_2)
  )
)

model_comparison |>
  kable(digits = 4)
```

## 6.2 Test Whether Additional Predictors Improve the Model

```{r compare-f-test}
anova(
  model_1,
  model_2
)
```
